definition: Report the participant was extracted from; joins to R_ID in lald_reports.csv.
Position of the participant in the source as numbered at extraction.
Phenotype as classified in the source: cholesteryl ester storage disease (CESD) or Wolman disease (WD); blank where not reported.
Age at first symptom, where reported separately from diagnosis.
Follow-up from diagnosis, or from the start of ERT where the source gives only that.
Enzyme replacement therapy with sebelipase alfa.
Age at the start of ERT.
Any lipid-lowering therapy, harmonized across the extraction fields that record lipid-lowering treatment.
Raised ALT or AST at baseline.
Growth failure or failure to thrive.
Number of dyslipidemia, hepatosplenomegaly, steatosis and cirrhosis present among those with a non-missing value; blank when all four are missing.
Total cholesterol after treatment, last value reported on treatment.
LAL activity measured in any tissue.
Baseline LAL activity as reported (value, units, tissue, reference range). Assays differ across sources and are not commensurable.
Disease recurrence in the liver graft.
Time from liver transplantation to recurrence.
LAL activity after liver transplantation as reported. A bare 1 or 0 was recorded at the original extraction without a value; its meaning was not documented.
LAL activity after hematopoietic stem-cell transplantation as reported.
Graft loss or death after hematopoietic stem-cell transplantation.
Time from hematopoietic stem-cell transplantation to graft loss.
Steatosis at follow-up as coded at the original extraction; the code key was not recorded. Analyzed as 2 = documented improvement versus 0 or 1 = no documented improvement.
Fibrosis at follow-up as coded at the original extraction; the code key was not recorded. Described only.
Lipid response at follow-up as coded at the original extraction; the code key was not recorded. Analyzed as 2 = documented improvement versus 0 or 1 = no documented improvement.
Hepatomegaly at follow-up as coded at the original extraction; the code key was not recorded. Described only.
Most complete document held for the source, and therefore the ceiling on what the row can carry; internal = institutional records.
The fields so coded; setting them to missing gives the coding-convention sensitivity analysis.
Overall risk of bias of the source.

Classification of the report before extraction: A = values verified against the full text in May 2026; B = listed as reporting group-level results only; C = moved out of the individual-participant arm. Tier A rows enter the fragility analysis.
Report; joins to R_ID in lald_reports.csv.
Reports describing wholly or partly the same patients share a group and are never pooled together; blank = no overlap.
Treatment arm or group the row describes.
metadata = study characteristic or eligibility; every other value carries a numerical result.
Form of the numerical result (proportion, mean_sd, median_iqr, effect_ci, ...).
Group mean, or the reported central value.
Standard deviation, or the reported dispersion; derivations are stated in note.

ipd = contributes individual participant data; aggregate = contributes group-level results only; excluded = assessed for eligibility, neither; duplicate = second record of a report, or report of patients already included, found on the full record.
Aggregate report contributing a number to a pooled estimate, a figure or a reported comparison; 0 = extracted and verified but contributing no number under the overlap and eligibility rules.
